```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 04_variability_differences
title: >
  Would you trust the same prediction for all three movies?
questions:
  - id: you_friend
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Compare your answer
    prompt: >
      Suppose one new review is added for each movie. Using the measures of central
      tendency from the previous chapter, what rating would you predict for each one?
      Explain what in the existing ratings would make you more or less confident in
      those predictions.
    answer: >
      A reasonable prediction is 5 for each movie because all three have a mean and
      median of 5. But I would be most confident about *Fine, Actually*, where every
      rating so far is 5, and least confident about *The Polarizing Express*, where
      every rating is far from 5. *The Good, the Bad and the Okay* sits somewhere
      in between.
```
